text: Cardivex achieved 12.3% market share in Q3, up 1.2pp YoY. Digital channel ROI reached 4.2x, highest across all channels. Rep visit frequency remained stable at 2.3 visits/HCP/quarter.
Total promotional spend of $45M across 6 channels. TV delivered highest absolute impact ($18M incremental revenue) but lowest ROI (1.8x). Email showed highest ROI (5.1x) but limited scalability.
Tier 1 HCPs (15% of base) generated 42% of TRx volume. Digital engagement increased 35% YoY among HCPs under 40. Conference attendance remained the strongest driver of new prescriber activation.
Market leader holds 28% share, stable QoQ. Two new entrants in the immunology space. Pricing pressure in cardiology segment intensifying. Generic competition expected in 18 months.
Bayesian MMM (PyMC-Marketing) estimated TV adstock half-life of 4.2 weeks. Saturation parameter (Hill): EC50=$3.2M, slope=1.8. Optimal budget allocation shifts 15% from TV to Digital.
